name: DISA
description: A transformer-based disassembly framework that recovers code layout and memory block boundaries on stripped binaries, feeding downstream CFG recovery.

name: iResolveX (under review, NDSS)
description: A multi-stage pipeline combining high-recall indirect-call target supersets with ML-guided re-ranking, producing p-IndirectCFG.

name: CAIR (targeting ASIACCS 2027)
description: A GNN-based, pluggable indirect-call refinement approach using Structured Call Refinement Graphs (SCRGs).

name: Agentic Fuzzing for Indirect-Call Ground Truth
description: An AFL++-based agentic fuzzer built to establish complete ground truth for indirect-call pairs via a residual-risk framing.

name: ACaM — Agent Capability Model (IBM Research)
description: A static analysis pipeline combining program analysis with LLM semantic-lifting to detect threats in LLM agent pipelines (LangChain/LangGraph, extending to CrewAI/AutoGen) — exfiltration chains, prompt injection, policy violations, LLM-poisoning-triggered exfiltration, and covert channels. Also covers information-flow/taint propagation across multi-agent pipelines, vulnerability scanning of deployed agentic systems, LLM-generated fuzzing grammars, and supply-chain attacks via description–implementation divergence (DID).
